facts.en: Completed a diploma in Business Technology at Fictional Institute D096 in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构院校 D096 完成商业技术专科学历。

facts.en: Worked as an operations systems clerk at Fictional Service Office D096 from 2023-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-01 至 2026-08 在虚构服务办公室 D096 担任运营系统文员。

facts.en: Entered approved request data into an internal workflow tool and routed incomplete records to process owners.
facts.zh: 将获批请求数据录入内部工作流工具，并将不完整记录转交流程负责人。

facts.en: Used saved filters and exported reports in that tool; did not configure permissions, integrations or system architecture.
facts.zh: 使用该工具的已保存筛选及报告导出；未配置权限、集成或系统架构。

facts.en: With a systems analyst, reviewed 125 request records during 2025-05.
facts.zh: 在 2025-05 与系统分析师合作复查 125 条请求记录。

facts.en: The team found 18 missing category values among those 125 records, obtained owner confirmation for 15 and left 3 flagged unresolved.
facts.zh: 团队在该批 125 条记录中发现 18 个缺失类别值，取得负责人对 15 个的确认，并保留 3 个未解决标记。

facts.en: Recorded user-reported workflow problems with screenshots and expected behavior for analyst review.
facts.zh: 记录用户报告的工作流问题，附截图及预期行为，供分析师审阅。

facts.en: Prepared a 2026-02 request-entry guide approved by the analyst for routine use.
facts.zh: 2026-02 准备请求录入指南，经分析师批准用于常规工作。

facts.en: Drafted a 2026-05 automation idea using a diagram; no automation was built or deployed.
facts.zh: 2026-05 用图示起草自动化构想；未构建或部署自动化。

facts.en: Completed a 2024-10 introductory SQL course using fictional tables and 12 practice queries.
facts.zh: 2024-10 使用虚构表格及 12 条练习查询完成 SQL 入门课程。

facts.en: The SQL course did not involve production database access or establish expert proficiency.
facts.zh: 该 SQL 课程不涉及生产数据库访问，也不证明专家熟练程度。

facts.en: Completed a 2025-03 spreadsheet workshop covering lookup formulas; no advanced professional credential was awarded.
facts.zh: 2025-03 完成涵盖查找公式的电子表格工作坊；未授予高级专业资格。

facts.en: Used lookup formulas to cross-check request IDs under an analyst-provided template.
facts.zh: 在分析师提供的模板中使用查找公式交叉核对请求编号。

facts.en: At the 2025-11 peak, supported 4 request queues; the normal 2026-08 allocation was 2.
facts.zh: 在 2025-11 高峰期支持 4 个请求队列；2026-08 常规分工为 2 个。

facts.en: Volunteered for Fictional Model Club V096 on Saturdays from 2024-02 to 2024-07 while employed, sorting instruction cards.
facts.zh: 2024-02 至 2024-07 任职期间，星期六在虚构模型社团 V096 志愿整理说明卡。

facts.en: Built a personal catalog of paper-aircraft designs in 2021, unrelated to enterprise systems.
facts.zh: 2021 年建立个人纸飞机设计目录，与企业系统无关。

facts.en: Keeps a watercolor notebook of imaginary weather scenes.
facts.zh: 保留描绘虚构天气场景的水彩笔记。

facts.en: A draft profile describes expert SQL and platform administration, although the evidence records coursework and ordinary user access only.
facts.zh: 一份简介草稿描述 SQL 专家能力及平台管理，但证据仅记录课程作业和普通用户访问。

facts.en: Tracked unresolved issues without choosing technical fixes or approving system changes.
facts.zh: 跟踪未解决问题，不选择技术修复或批准系统变更。

facts.en: Maintained source references and change notes so analysts could trace corrected data fields.
facts.zh: 维护源引用及变更备注，使分析师能够追溯更正数据字段。
